description:
Auto Colonies
Automatic Faction and Colony management for Starsector 0.98a+0.98.5a.

Source code and guides
Required mods: None.
Updating: Delete the old folder in mods/ and extract the new one, or just use TriOS. Saves and settings carry over.
Safe to add mid-game

Safe to remove after Prepare for removal

No known mod conflicts

Story mode (default)
It starts with the autopilot dormant, and your colonies run like the base game.
A message in your PDA starts the story, and you unlock the mod as you go.
Playing through the story takes you past the normal autopilot to some truly game-breaking end-tier colony stuff.
New games use Story by default.

This is the intended way to play!

Normal mode
It works as normal Auto Colonies, where you set each colony to Advise, Approve or Auto. Auto takes over buildings, patrols, items and so on.
Pick Normal in the first pop-up if you'd rather skip the story, but you won't get the end-tier stuff.

Every action still costs credits in both modes.

You can switch any time in LunaLib (F3), under Auto Colonies, and each save keeps its story progress.

Features
Building
It ranks every building from your mods (or just vanilla) and builds toward a balanced profile, or whatever you pick: ship hulls, weapons, fuel, income and so on.
Items, AI cores and administrators
These go where your doctrine says. Autopilot has its own storage and ships items to the colonies that need them, for a small fee and some time.
Money ladder and capital
It puts money where it matters most, in this order:
It stockpiles first, then grows colonies.
Then it builds up the military, with new ships and more patrols.
Then it makes new colonies.
Then it balances your whole economy.
Last, it builds wonders, optimizes everything and picks your biggest colony as the capital (you can change that in the settings).

War (Nexerelin)
Retaliate is the default war level, and every faction gets a default stance (tell me if a mod's faction is missing). If a war starts, it fights back until the war ends by building fleets, raiding, invading and retaking your planets. It can also attack Hegemony AI inspections and Persean enforcers, for a cost (off by default).
Security
It protects your colonies and kicks in when an invasion force shows up, or you can set a planet to security full-time. It's about defending, not attacking. There's an optional Low profile style. Kills by your patrols and stations count toward colony crises and Tri-Tachyon commerce raiding, like your own kills (on by default).
New colonies (optional)
It uses Nexerelin colony fleets to settle the most useful planet nearby. It can make mistakes, so I'd only use it with a big empire and limits off, like five size 5 colonies and a 30-colony limit.
Costs
Every action costs a bit of money to balance out it all being automatic. Even so, it's pretty busted: an omega-level AI building out your colonies fast will have you raking in credits. Audit page.
Settings
They're in LunaLib (F3), under Auto Colonies. Each colony's Autopilot panel opens from the button on the colony screen. Every setting

Supported mods
They're all optional, and each one turns on with its mod.
Large integrations
Nexerelin It handles war level, stances, agents, diplomacy, sieges and colony fleets.
Ashes of the Domain (Vaults of Knowledge, Theory of Toolbox), Building Menu Overhaul It runs research, synergies, management styles, trade contracts, megastructures and wonders.
Terraforming Made Easy It follows special-world plans, terraforms and upgrades stable locations.
Industrial Evolution It handles ambassadors, edicts, VPC chips, special mining and refining, and courier shipping.
Buildings and colonies
Terraforming & Station Construction (Boggled) It runs terraforming and can turn mining and siphon stations into colonies (optional).
Random Assortment of Things It handles the Frontiers settlement and the Expedition Hub, which gets an AI core when the extra range pays off.
Grand.Colonies It builds past 12 buildings and counts the extra upkeep.
Substance.Abuse It handles breweries and recipes.
Volkov Industrial Conglomerate It treats viral contamination first and only puts soil nanites on vanilla farmland.
Roider Union It values Dives and the Union HQ by the colony's deposits and places Roider Charters.
Planetary Shield: Access Control The shield is valued as more defense, and the port is kept closed while there are Pather cells on the planet.
Unknown Skies, What We Left Behind, Astral Ascension It knows their mining conditions and water worlds and keeps planetless colonies safe. It also builds the Aegis Missile System for defense once you know its blueprint.
Niko's Scavengable Industries It will build known blueprints, while risky blueprints are left to you to build.
Junk Yard Dogs, Carter's Freetraders It builds resource forges and the Biolab and counts illegal goods.
Vulpoids It handles Organ Farms, the Biotech Facility, their items and Profecto administrators.
Yunru Industries, Yunru's Worlds, Slightly Better Tech-Mining (one thread for all three) It builds Secondary Drydocks and Auxiliary Shipbays and counts the richer Tech-Mining.
Rogue Planets Its 31 conditions and synergies count, and story worlds are left to you.
Kadur Remnant, JaydeePiracy, Corrupt.Officials, Tahlan Shipworks, Gladiator Society, SCY, CJY's Toy Box, AI-Retrofits, Blue, Oculian Armada Their conditions, income rules and shipyards count. Story planets and risky buildings are left to you.
Auto Outfitting It plans producers for the goods Auto Outfitting's weapon orders need.
Stations
Station Augments It picks the augment loadout for each station.
Interstellar Imperium, Knights of Ludd Their stations count like vanilla ones.
Items and AI cores
Emergent Threats (IX Revival) It handles the Antimatter Stabilizer conversion and puts Panopticon cores in the Surveillance Center.
Omega Core Everywhere, Astral Ascension Renewed It places Omega cores.
United Aurora Federation It places their colony items by what they do, and it restores ruins where an administrator with Galactic Historian governs.
Other mods
Any other mod It reads deposits and items from the game's tables and measures buildings on a test colony. Smaller integrations (Cloning, Coalesced Little Mods, Reverse Engineered Private Arsenal, Sol Renewed, Toolbox Economy Curves, Secrets of the Frontier, Remnant Retribution, Adversary) are under Supported mods on GitHub.

Ask here or on GitHub if you want support for another mod.

Compatibility and permissions
Compatibility and known issues
Optional integrations: See Supported mods.
Tested with: I play it with about 100 mods, and every release gets checked offline with every mix of the five mods it hooks into (Nexerelin, Industrial Evolution, Random Assortment of Things, Station Augments, LunaLib). Other mods are found by ID, so missing ones are skipped.
Known conflicts: None known.
Known issues: Expect bugs. Report them here or as GitHub issues, with your starsector.log, saves/common/colony_autopilot_diagnostics.json.data and modlist.
Permissions
Code: It's free to use, change and reupload, in modpacks too. No credit needed, just don't sell it.
Assets: The Autarch AI Core's icon, portrait and skill icon are mine (made with Midjourney) and follow the same rules as the code. The banner uses the game's own art and fonts, which belong to Fractal Softworks.

FAQ
Adding to a game in progress
It's safe, and colonies start on Advisor. To remove it, turn on Prepare for removal (LunaLib or the Mod features page), save, then take it out.

Colony crises
Low profile lowers the odds (pick it in the first colony dialog or in Settings, Expansion style). Pirate and Persean League crises only depend on colony size.

Nothing is being built
Check the mode (Advisor only recommends), then the budget.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code, docs and offline build checks: Claude Opus 5.5 (through Claude Code).
Design and in-game testing: Mjolniar.
Training data: None added. Art: The Autarch AI Core's icon, portrait and skill icon were made with Midjourney.

Made by Mjolniar | More: Auto Outfitting | Auto-er Pilot | all my mods on GitHub

Includes a story mode that unlocks advanced features and a normal mode for standard automation. Integrates with various other mods to handle specific mechanics like terraforming, research, and station management.
